subject: Cascade & Lockdown: Objective alignment and QBR playbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cascade & Lockdown: Objective alignment and QBR playbook

Team —

We need to lock the OKR set for the quarter and get the consolidated QBR playbook into a state we can present to the board on 4/22. Attached are two drafts: a working playbook (QBR_Playbook_v0.9.pdf) and a cascade table (OKR_Cascade_Table_v3.xlsx). Key asks:

1) Please review the Objectives + Key Results column in the spreadsheet and mark any scope changes in the rightmost "proposed change" column by EOD Friday 4/15.
2) Leadership to confirm which top-line metrics we will report on in the QBR (latency p50/p95, reserved utilization, unit cost/token).
3) Confirm owners for cross-functional asks (console, dedicated, private).

I propose a short lock call on Monday 4/18 10:00–10:30 PT if needed — put tentative hold on calendar. If there are major disagreements, flag them in-thread with a short note on impact.

Thanks —
Priyom
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_Playbook_v0.9.pdf (pdf), OKR_Cascade_Table_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cascade & Lockdown: Objective alignment and QBR playbook

Priyom —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a first pass on the cascade table:

- Suggest tightening Objective 2 wording to focus on "predictable tail latency" rather than generic latency — helps align SRE metrics.
- For the QBR, I want one slide with the failure-budget burn-down and one with our fallback policy outcomes for last quarter (this helped reassure a prospective enterprise).

I’ll review the attached playbook and add slide suggestions in the doc by Thursday morning. I support the 4/18 lock call but prefer 9:30 PT if scheduling works for folks.

—Laura
VP, GTM Strategy

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cascade & Lockdown: Objective alignment and QBR playbook

Thanks — high level direction:

1) We should limit the board QBR deck to three business-facing themes (Reliability, Unit Economics, Expansion). Each theme should have a single metric and one narrative case study.
2) OKR lock: any change that modifies target thresholds (e.g., lowering p95 target) must include a mitigation plan and an owner. No target relaxations without approval.
3) For the lock call, 9:30 PT on 4/18 works for me.

Priyom, Laura — can you ensure the playbook has a short appendix with rollback criteria and escalation steps? Marissa, include runbook links in the appendix.

—Vivek
CEO

Adding operational clarity:

- I put the runbook links at the end of the playbook (see appendix URLs). The runbooks include canary thresholds, rollback steps, and owner on-call IDs.
- On the cascade table, I've populated the owner column for infra and SRE asks. A few product owners are still TBD — Aditya, can you confirm assignments for model catalog and optimize flows?
- Noting a dependency on SOC 2 audit evidence for Private deployment metrics. Monica, can your team confirm if we'll have audit artifacts by 4/20?

Attachments: runbook_index.txt (list)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cascade & Lockdown: Objective alignment and QBR playbook

Attaching a cleaned cascade table with owner assignments and proposed metric definitions. I adjusted Objective 3 to separate dedicated reserved utilization from burst utilization (two distinct KR lines).

Please review the sheet — I marked cells that require sign-off in yellow. I also added a short notes column with tradeoffs (latency vs cost).

Attachments: OKR_Cascade_Table_v3_clean.xlsx

Date: 2027-04-15T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cascade & Lockdown: Objective alignment and QBR playbook — FINAL LOCK

Team —

Thank you for the fast turn. Summary and final asks: 

- We are locking the Objectives and Key Results as reflected in OKR_Cascade_Table_v3_clean.xlsx (attached). Changes accepted are limited to wording clarifications and owner assignments; no target relaxations were approved.
- QBR playbook v1.0 is attached for acceptance. Vivek asked for three business themes — slide mapping is in the cover notes.
- Action items: 
  * Laura: finalize the board narrative slides by 4/19 EOD.
  * Marissa: confirm runbook artifacts and SOC 2 evidence availability by 4/20.
  * Aditya: mark final owner confirmations and upload cascade table to the shared drive (done).
  * Monica & Rishi: prep the cost/finance slide for the QBR and validate unit-cost math.

If there are objections, raise them in-thread by 4/16 noon PT — otherwise I will mark this thread as locked and circulate the board packet on 4/19 morning.

Thanks —
Priyom
Head of Product Operations

Attachments: QBR_Playbook_v1.0.pdf, OKR_Cascade_Table_v3_clean.xlsx
